title.title: Kirchberg's $\mathcal O_2$ ultrapower embedding problem
title.subtitle: Claim: a separable unital C*-algebra that embeds in no ultrapower $\mathcal O_2^\omega$, nor any nuclear ultrapower

beats.text: Kirchberg–Phillips: every separable exact C*-algebra embeds in $\mathcal O_2$
Kirchberg asked: does every separable C*-algebra embed in the ultrapower $\mathcal O_2^\omega$?
Claim: no. $C^*(G)$ for one explicit group embeds in no nuclear ultrapower

achievement.label: Kirchberg's embedding problem
statement: A \hookrightarrow \mathcal O_2^\omega \text{ for every separable } A\,?
achievement.note: No unital embedding into $B^\omega$ for any nonzero unital nuclear $B$

verify.detail: The non-embedding theorem is in Lean; the paper is 14 pages
verify.ourCheck: We compared the Lean scope with the claim; we did not build it

plain: Is there one tidy universal algebra that every separable algebra fits inside? No: here is one that doesn't

steps: Suppose the algebra fit inside a nuclear ultrapower
Then each matched representation needs a predecessor match
Finite chains of matches are forced to repeat: a contradiction

data.assume: an embedding into a nuclear ultrapower

voice.text: Every separable exact algebra embeds in O two. Does every one fit in its ultrapower?
If it fit, every matched representation needs a predecessor, but finite chains must repeat.
Claimed: one explicit group algebra fits nowhere nuclear.
